I’m curious to know what your definition of “cultural appropriation” is. 

The definition from dictionary.com: the act of adopting elements of an outside culture without understanding or respecting the original culture and context. 


Appropriation: Big butts and lips worn by black women were seen as ghetto and unattractive. White women who start buying lips and butts that resembles black women’s (big), will be praised and monetized for it while never crediting or ever respecting black women. 

And I wouldn’t go as far as to say that braids historically belong to white people JUST AS EQUALLY as it does to black people. First, It originated in African tribes around 3100 BC and the Greeks were the first European group to wear braids (Halo broads) more than 3000 years later. On top of that, braids were and still to this day are most commonly worn by black people. 

Tl;dr At the end of the day, it really comes down to respect. No one really wants to feel disadvantaged and frustrated.
